en: A colorized historic postcard view over a European city street lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with tiled roofs. The scene looks down Ullrichstrasse with a large neoclassical building on the right and residential blocks stretching into the distance. In the background, houses climb a hill crowned by a pavilion-like structure. The lower margin bears printed captions identifying the location and publisher.
